opportunity.title: Archival claim rescue with preserved uncertainty
opportunity.thesis: Test whether an explicitly specified linear contrast can be answered without selecting one transcription, preserving glyph ambiguity, shared calibration and sparse source errors. Established certain-answer and query-cleaning methods challenge novelty; flagship status is withheld.
opportunity.goal: Return exact linear-contrast bounds over declared glyph alternatives, shared calibration offsets and sparse row errors, with extremal witnesses.
opportunity.successMetric: Bounds and witnesses agree with an independently authored exhaustive oracle on every valid finite case; unsupported cases are refused. Technical correctness does not pass the separate novelty or market gate.

witness.original_purpose: Answer an explicitly specified linear contrast of archived numerical measurements, preserving all declared transcription, calibration and source-error uncertainty.
witness.binding_restriction: A conventional transcribe-every-cell workflow postpones analysis until a single dataset is fixed; naive per-cell intervals discard shared calibration dependence.
witness.proposed_change: Compute the exact minimum and maximum of the unchanged query over an explicitly bounded set of admissible records and emit extremal witnesses. Permit a claim only if every admitted world supports it.
preserved_obligations: Unchanged specified weighted sum and threshold
Up to the complete stated number of signed row errors
Unresolved conclusions and failed cases remain visible
witness.acceptance_requirements: Exact lower/upper and valid extremal witnesses equal independent enumeration on every valid case; correctly refuse malformed and unsupported inputs.
falsifiers: Existing strong methods provide the same functional contract with no demonstrated additional capability or effort advantage.
Observed gain depends on dropping correlated uncertainty, assuming unsupported source calibration, or changing the query.
Usefulness disappears when the cost of constructing/validating the admissible set is included.
witness.source_scope: Research-authored finite possible-world cases, not source-verified historical data or a climate conclusion.
witness.prior_art_gate: Must document a substantive advance beyond certain-answer databases, query-guided cleaning, robust optimization and existing archive transcription tools. Efficient implementation or renaming alone fails. Current status: UNPROVEN.
